capabilities: Publish notes to a GitHub-backed blog
Upload article images and cover to WeChat
extras: macOS only and requires Obsidian Desktop 1.12.0 or later. Full setup and troubleshooting are in a separate user guide. No hosted relay, telemetry, or browser automation; credentials use Obsidian SecretStorage. WeChat publishing creates a draft only; final sending is manual in WeChat.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a note to an external blog or a WeChat Official Account.

relations.evidence: publishing the current Markdown note to a GitHub-backed blog
or to a WeChat Official Account draft

requires.name: GitHub fine-grained token with Contents: write access

summary: Desktop plugin that publishes the current Markdown note to a GitHub-backed blog or a WeChat Official Account draft.
